tools.name: ansi_image_to_ansi
tools.description: Convert a still image to one-color-per-cell ANSI block art (CP437-style, xterm-256 palette) using pure Pillow -- no LLM. Nearest-matches each downsampled pixel to the app's own xterm-256 color table so the result renders identically in the app's own .ans viewer. Reimplements the technique behind rez2ans-next-style image-to-ANSI converters in-process.

src.description: Path to the input image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, etc.)

cols.description: Output width in character columns (default 80, clamped to 120)

colors.description: Palette size: 256 for the xterm-256 color cube + grayscale ramp (photographic), or 16 for the DOS/BBS system palette (retro look)

tools.name: ansi_image_is_available
tools.description: Return true if the ansi-image plugin's only dependency (Pillow) is importable
